title: Agent Tools & RAG
summary: This module equips agents with diverse tools for interacting with external systems and data, and provides a robust framework for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to enhance knowledge retrieval and utilization.

nodes.label: RAG Loaders & Chunkers
nodes.title: Data Ingestion for RAG
nodes.description: Provides data loaders for various sources (files, web, databases) and utilities for chunking text, preparing content for Retrieval-Augmented Generation.

nodes.label: RAG Vector Store Management
nodes.title: Vector Database Integration
nodes.description: Manages vector databases (e.g., ChromaDB, Qdrant) for storing and retrieving embeddings, forming the core of the RAG system.

nodes.label: Tool Adapters & Specifications
nodes.title: Tool Integration & Definition
nodes.description: Offers adapters to integrate external systems as CrewAI tools and extracts detailed specifications for dynamic tool loading and documentation.

nodes.label: File Management & Caching
nodes.title: File Handling & Cleanup
nodes.description: Provides utilities for managing files, including caching, cleanup, and resolution for various file sources and providers, supporting RAG and tools.

nodes.label: Specific Agent Tools
nodes.title: Diverse Agent Capabilities
nodes.description: A comprehensive collection of pre-built, specialized tools for agents, covering web scraping, data querying, file management, and various platform integrations.

nodes.label: CrewAI Agents
nodes.title: Intelligent Agents
nodes.description: The core AI agents within the CrewAI framework that utilize tools and RAG capabilities to perform tasks.

nodes.label: External Data Sources
nodes.title: Raw Information Providers
nodes.description: Represents various external sources of raw data, such as documents, websites, and databases, that are ingested by RAG loaders.

nodes.label: External APIs & Services
nodes.title: Third-Party Integrations
nodes.description: External systems and APIs that CrewAI agents interact with through specialized tools to perform actions or retrieve information.

groups.label: RAG System Core
groups.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation
groups.description: The central components responsible for ingesting, processing, storing, and retrieving knowledge for agents.

groups.label: Tool Infrastructure
groups.title: Tooling & File Support
groups.description: Provides the foundational services for defining, integrating, and managing tools, along with file handling capabilities.

groups.label: Agent Toolset
groups.title: Agent's Action Capabilities
groups.description: The collection of ready-to-use tools that empower CrewAI agents to perform a wide range of actions and interact with external systems.

groups.label: System Interactions
groups.title: External System Interfaces
groups.description: Represents the external entities that interact with or are utilized by the agent tools and RAG system.
